attributes.residual: THE 16T/15O SLOT DELTA IS DECOMPOSED AND NAMED. slotdiff (frame 448=448, saves r21=r21): the target places a contiguous 64-byte block -- mat[16] -- at r1+68..132 (target-only slots 68,72,76,84,88,92,100,104,108,112,116,120,124,128,132 plus 20), while our build places the SAME block 80 bytes higher at r1+148..208 (ours-only slots 148..208 plus 64). The displacement is caused by the alias-record's `u8 unused[48]` frame-size pad: MWCC seats that declared pad in the low local region where the target seats mat[16], pushing our mat to r1+148. This is the InitCamera instance of the swbos mechanism (a declared u8 pad reproduces frame SIZE but not the below/around-pool ARRANGEMENT): declared locals allocate ABOVE the compiler temp pool, so no reordering of {mat,in,out,unused} can drop mat beneath the pad -- confirmed by 3 orderings, baseline (16T/15O) being the closest. The underlying 56-genuine-structural-row / whole-function GPR-FPR colour permutation (attempt.initcamera-alias-lever-and-frame-pad.20260831.v1) is STACKED under this slot delta and is not addressable until the block is seated. DO NOT re-probe local-declaration reordering of these four locals (measured dead 3x). UNPARK CONDITION: recover the REAL local(s) the 48-byte pad stands in for and give them the type/placement that lets mat[16] take r1+68 -- i.e. reconstruct the original's sub-pool locals rather than pad the frame; a plain u8 pad cannot seat below the temp pool.
